en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a mountainous, forested landscape with a mining ropeway (aerial tramway) in the foreground. Wooden support towers carry cables with suspended ore buckets moving along the line. Below, scattered buildings and mining structures sit on a rocky slope, with wide hills and valleys in the distance. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.
